canonical_truth_statement: This research bundle is incomplete based only on its recorded evidence; it is not a repository release-readiness certification.

phases.name: Align to current truth
phases.notes: Only recorded source observations are treated as evidence; evidence role and retrieval limits remain explicit.

phases.name: Separate stale state from active evidence
phases.notes: Explicitly tagged historical/archive sources: 0. No source records were deleted or rewritten.

phases.name: Integrate evidence and provenance
phases.notes: 21 evidence items link to source locators.

lanes.completion_gate: Every compared configuration has source-verified efficiency, range, and price fields or explicit unknowns.
lanes.evidence_contract: Primary EPA/DOE vehicle records and dated manufacturer or government price/incentive sources, with exact model-year and trim locators.
lanes.scope: Identify current U.S. 2025-2026 EV model/trim configurations, EPA MPGe/range, MSRP, and applicable incentive evidence.

lanes.completion_gate: Every computed cost identifies observed inputs, derived calculation, uncertainty, and missing geography-specific values.
lanes.evidence_contract: Dated government/utility/research data with units, geography, assumptions, and methodology.
lanes.scope: Gather electricity-price, public charging, maintenance/repair, depreciation, insurance, and cost-model inputs for 5- and 10-year scenarios.

lanes.completion_gate: Known issues are tied to a source and applicable model year; absence of evidence is not presented as absence of defects.
lanes.evidence_contract: NHTSA and manufacturer records plus transparently attributed reliability data; recalls are matched to year/trim/VIN scope.
lanes.scope: Check model-year-specific recalls, complaints, warranty terms, repair patterns, and source limitations.

lanes.completion_gate: No winner or cost claim is stated without complete, traceable inputs; unresolved objectives remain visible.
lanes.evidence_contract: Claim/evidence-linked comparison table, assumptions, contradictions, sensitivity analysis, objective matrix, and limitations.
lanes.scope: Reconcile lane evidence, calculate scenario-based costs, challenge rankings, and report conditional recommendations.

phases.name: Map lanes and owners
phases.notes: 4 declared lanes; declaration is not proof that parallel agents were run.

phases.name: Publish canonical research status
phases.notes: Canonical status is recorded in this bundle only; repository, package metadata, and public documentation were not modified.

phases.name: Test and validate evidence
phases.notes: Structural claim/citation validation ran; it does not establish semantic entailment or release readiness.

phases.name: Harmonize archive and active truth
phases.notes: Historical/archive evidence remains preserved and separately tagged; no archival migration was performed.
